name: fill_me_project_spec
title: Human-readable project implementation name
description: Project-level implementation contract shared by multiple coverage targets.

implementation_model.coverage_runner: How coverage Spike is run for this project.
implementation_model.compile_boundary: What must not be mixed with coverage collection.
implementation_model.summary_policy: How target/run-specific coverage summaries are selected.

notes: Fill this with the coverage Spike ISA/profile accepted by this project's Spike binary.
Do not blindly serialize every YES row from isa_profile.support into --isa; platform rows and implementation attributes may not be Spike ISA tokens.
Use must_include_isa_tokens for support-matrix rows or aliases that must be present in default_isa.
If this project intentionally needs a one-off runner command, pass --command-template for that run instead of changing the project default.

available_implementation_features: List implementation surfaces that targets may select from.
excluded_implementation_features: List unsupported project implementation surfaces that targets must not silently include.
target_policy: Targets choose concrete coverage slices under this project implementation.
